answer: Vesting with clawback turns a sybil farm into a slow, risky bet. Each new identity's rewards stay locked for many epochs, and any locked balance is forfeit if the identity is later traced to a ring of clones. A farmer who lets thousands of accounts wander the network must wait out the whole lock, while one reused cipher key or one shared funding path cracks the set like a flawed opal, burning every account at once. Honest agents lose nothing by waiting.
